comment: Golden run mapping for Qalyub sector 1 (rules from the build plan's known content). drawingUnit 'm' is a TEST PARAMETER of the golden run only, NOT a product default: the drawing unit has no default and is chosen by the PM per drawing (ADR-018, still awaiting the technical office; the drawing declares $INSUNITS=1 inches while its coordinates read as UTM 36N metres). expected.routes and expected.routeLengthM stay null until regenerated with the real drawing (UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 scripts/golden.sh).
